question: What are the evaluation criteria and their weights used in Level IV of the LACERS 2025 actuarial consulting services RFP?
gold_answer: Professionalism 15; Proposed Scope of Services Description and Methodology 30; Qualifications, Experience, and Accomplishments 35; Value of Cost 20; Total 100.
acceptance: Professionalism15, proposed scope/method30, qualifications/experience35, value/cost20. Points or percentages accepted because weights total100.
candidate_answer:
In **Level IV — Proposed Services and Compensation**, LACERS evaluates the proposed services and fees using these criteria:

| Criterion | Weight |
|---|---:|
| Professionalism of the RFP response | 15% |
| Proposed scope of services and methodology | 30% |
| Qualifications, experience, and accomplishments | 35% |
| Value of cost | 20% |
| **Total** | **100%** |

The cost criterion considers the **relative cost and value** of the proposed fee, including qualitative considerations—not necessarily price alone. Source: *LACERS 2025 Actuarial Consulting Services RFP*, pp. 14–15.
